breadth.label: Percent of S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA
breadth.note: Below 30 bullish, above 70 bearish. Computed by Thaddeus from Yahoo Finance daily closes for 501 of 503 current S&P 500 constituents at the Nov. 12 close (mimics MMFI). Down from 71.9% and just under the 70 line.

fear_greed.commentary: Fear & Greed edged up to 40 (fear) from 37 even as the Nvidia shock and surging yields hit, and it is far above 24 a week ago but still below 46 a month ago, so sentiment is recovering from extreme fear without turning confident.

markets.summary: Wall Street absorbed a big Nvidia shock with modest losses Thursday: the S&P 500 fell 0.35% to 7,592.40, the Dow 0.36% to 52,297.09 and the Nasdaq 0.39% to 25,366.09, about 2.9% below the S&P's October record. Nvidia's board removed CEO Jensen Huang and the stock closed down 4.34% at $166.19 after plunging as much as 16% intraday, while AMD and Broadcom rallied about 6% each. Small caps lagged, with the Russell 2000 down 1.66% to 2,799.06 and slipping back below its 40-week average. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.1% as markets priced roughly an 85% chance of a December Fed rate hike. Gold futures dropped 2.88% to $3,885.30 and silver futures 3.68% to $49.97, both well below their 40-week averages with gold at its lowest since late 2025. Friday brings the October producer price index and SpaceX's Starship Flight 15 launch attempt.

stories.headline: Nvidia announces CEO transition: Jensen Huang resigns, Colette Kress interim CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia said Huang resigned as CEO and board member effective immediately, CFO Kress is interim CEO, and Harvey Jones becomes first board chair; Q3 earnings are still set for Nov. 17.

stories.headline: Nvidia stock falls after Jensen Huang resigns
stories.summary: Shares dived as much as 16% before ending down 4.3%, with Nvidia's market value barely holding above $4 trillion amid investor worry over a succession plan.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns in blow to AI boom he helped foster
stories.summary: Reuters reports retail investors bought the dip and rivals AMD and Broadcom rose, with CFO Kress and Ian Buck seen as leading internal candidates.

stories.headline: Is SpaceX stock a buy before its first try at catching a Starship upper stage?
stories.summary: SPCX closed at $139.94 as SpaceX targets Friday, Nov. 13 for Flight 15, pending regulatory approval, with the first attempt to catch both booster and ship.

stories.headline: SpaceX Starship Flight 15 live updates: T-1 day to first double landing attempt
stories.summary: Liftoff is planned for 5:45 p.m. EDT Friday from Starbase, Texas, carrying 26 Starlink V3 satellites.

stories.headline: CCJ's share of uranium output down 20% in Q3: will 2026 targets be met?
stories.summary: Cameco's Q3 production fell to 3.5 million pounds on an extended Key Lake mill shutdown, and it narrowed 2026 production guidance to 19.5-20.5 million pounds.

stories.headline: The best uranium stocks to buy and hold as nuclear power expands
stories.summary: CCJ fell 3.42% to $71.78 Thursday, and Motley Fool argues long-term contracting and nuclear demand keep the case intact.

headlines.headline: How major US stock indexes fared Thursday
headlines.summary: Stocks absorbed big swings in Nvidia and oil and finished with relatively modest losses after the S&P 500 erased an early near-1% drop.

headlines.headline: Gold, silver slide as Treasury yields surge, Fed hike concerns intensify
headlines.summary: Spot gold fell below $3,900 and silver to about $50 as futures priced roughly 85% odds of a 25-basis-point hike in December; Friday's PPI is the next test.

stories.headline: Douglas County's growth slows as Highlands Ranch ages
stories.summary: State estimates show Douglas County added 6,464 residents from mid-2024 to mid-2025, second-most in Colorado, but unincorporated areas including Highlands Ranch grew only 0.9%, and the school district has merged six Highlands Ranch elementaries into three amid falling enrollment.

stories.headline: Appeals court rejects Douglas County's challenge to county-worker union law
stories.summary: The Colorado Court of Appeals unanimously upheld dismissal of the county's suit against the state's county collective-bargaining law, finding the county lacked standing without ruling on the law itself.

stories.headline: Casualties rise after Brooklyn building collapse
stories.summary: NPR reports the toll continues to climb following a building collapse in Brooklyn, with photos from the scene.

stories.headline: Widespread Microsoft outage hits Outlook and other apps
stories.summary: A broad outage knocked out Microsoft's Outlook email and other services Thursday.

stories.headline: Home sales fall to their lowest level in 16 years
stories.summary: NPR reports U.S. home sales have dropped to a 16-year low, a blow described as a 'punch in the gut' for the market.

stories.headline: Van Hollen to challenge Schumer for Senate majority leader
stories.summary: Maryland Sen. Chris Van Hollen says he will run against Chuck Schumer to lead Senate Democrats.

stories.headline: Cindy Holscher wins Kansas governor's race
stories.summary: Democrat Cindy Holscher won the Kansas governorship, keeping the office in Democratic hands.

stories.headline: No. 4 Michigan State hockey falls 3-2 in overtime at Notre Dame
stories.summary: Shane Vansaghi scored twice, but the Spartans lost their Big Ten opener in OT despite outshooting the Irish 35-33; MSU is 6-3-0 and plays game two Friday night.

stories.summary: Satire: the outage turns out to be the best thing to happen to the workday.

stories.summary: Satire: the Caped Crusader opts for pockets.

stories.summary: Satire: the late-night brawls finally get monetized.

weather.summary: A deep upper trough over the East brings snow to Michigan's Upper Peninsula and northern Lower Peninsula, parts of Illinois and Indiana, and lake-effect snow into the Northeast through Saturday, with rain from the Northeast into the Mid-Atlantic and Ohio Valley and freeze and frost alerts from Oklahoma and Arkansas to the interior Gulf Coast. Out West, heavy snow and high winds hit the Sierra Nevada, and a front brings rain and thunderstorms to the West Coast Friday, spreading inland Saturday with mixed rain and snow reaching the Rockies.
